
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readr)

library(INLA)
library(inlabru)
library(fmesher)
library(sp)
library(sf)

source(here('src', 'modeling.R'))

if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  windowsFonts(playfair = windowsFont("Playfair Display"))
}
```

# Data

```{r}
events <- read_csv(here('data', 'processed', 'events.csv')) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(team_with_poss = team_id)

tracking <- read_csv(here('data', 'processed', 'tracking.csv')) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(period = period_id)

ball <- tracking %>% 
  filter(player_id == 'ball') %>% 
  select(period, time_sec_orig, x_ball = x_pitch, y_ball = y_pitch, match_id)

pitch_length <- 105
pitch_width <- 68
```

```{r}
event_type = "SHOT"
event_subtype = NA
start_time = 30
end_time = 0
pred_time_event = 0

dataset <- prepare_data(events, tracking, event_type, event_subtype, start_time, end_time, pred_time_event)

dataset_sf <- dataset %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = NA)
```

# Mesh

```{r}
mesh <- create_meshes(dataset, max.edge = c(3, 12),offset = c(5, 15), cutoff = 2)
```

```{r}
plot(mesh$s)
```

# SPDE Prior

```{r}
spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh$s,
  prior.sigma = c(1, 0.01),
  prior.range = c(100, 0.99)
)
```

# FIT

```{r}
cmp <- ~ Intercept(1) +
  field(
    geometry,
    model = spde,
    group = time_sec,
    group_mapper = bru_mapper(mesh$t, indexed=TRUE),
    control.group = list(model = "ar1")
  )
```


```{r}
ips <- fm_int(
    domain = list(geometry = mesh$s, time_sec = mesh$t),
    samplers = list(geometry = mesh$poly)
  )

fit <- bru(
  cmp,
  bru_obs(
    geometry + time_sec ~ .,
    family = "cp",
    data = dataset_sf,
    ips = ips
  ),
  options = list(control.compute = list(waic = TRUE, dic = TRUE))
)

```

```{r}
summary(fit)

saveRDS(fit, here("output", "fit", "fit_temporal.RDS"))
```

```{r}
ppxl <- fm_pixels(mesh$s, mask = mesh$poly, format = "sf")
ppxl_all <- fm_cprod(ppxl, data.frame(time_sec = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25:30)))

lambda1 <- predict(
  fit,
  ppxl_all,
  ~ data.frame(time_sec = time_sec, lambda = exp(Intercept + field))
)

saveRDS(lambda1, here("output", "pred", "pred_temporal.RDS"))
```
# IMAGES

```{r}
lambda0 <- lambda1 %>% filter(time_sec %in% c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30))

plt_mean <- ggplot() +
  gg(lambda0, geom = "tile", aes(fill = mean, color = mean)) +
  facet_wrap(~time_sec) +
  annotate_pitch(
    dimensions = pitch_international,
    fill       = NA,
    colour     = "white",
    alpha      = 0.6,  # Slightly increased for better contrast against magma
    linewidth  = 0.5   # Ensure crisp, professional lines
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    na.value = "transparent",
    name = "Intensity"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    na.value = "transparent",
    guide = "none" # Prevents a duplicate legend from showing up
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, 105), 
    ylim = c(0, 68), 
    expand = FALSE 
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 5, xend = 25, y = 4, yend = 4,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "playfair", base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1A1A1A", colour = NA), # Dark background makes magma glow
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#DDDDDD", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.title = element_blank(), 
    axis.text = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(24, 28, 18, 28),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = "#DDDDDD", linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text       = element_text(
      colour = "#111111", size = 12, face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 8, b = 8)
    )
  )

plt_mean
ggsave(here("output" , "img", "temp_mean.pdf"), plot = plt_mean, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
